status: User-approved graduated thread-length revision; approved for production

assets.prompt: Transparent background. Create a PNG asset of these same pulled-back tattered drapes, changing ONLY the progression of the hanging threads. Keep both top corners filled with cloth, the central opening empty, and the upper 60 percent free of hanging strands. Around 60 percent down the canvas, begin with tiny short loose threads. As their attachment points descend along each inner fabric edge, the threads become progressively longer: tiny at the start, modest midway down the lower edge, then long fine strands near the bottom that trail toward and occasionally beyond the bottom frame. The increase in length should be gradual and clearly visible, not a sudden row of equally long strings. Use sparse uneven spacing, mixed neighboring lengths and subtle natural waviness, like antique cloth gently unraveling. Fine single threads, not cords, knots or bundled tassels. Preserve the broad fabric silhouettes, full top corners, impasto texture, source blue and apricot colors and lightness. No other changes. Actual transparent alpha background in the opening and between threads, 1536x1024 landscape.
